review_notes: GLB v2 structure passes with one mesh, one skin, 24 joints, 15463 triangles and six clips (Idle, Casual_Walk, Observe, Collect, Speak plus the Armature baselayer alias).

Visual review: each clip was rendered in a three.js AnimationMixer viewer and captured. Feet stay grounded, scale is stable, and Observe/Collect/Speak read as distinct, concept-appropriate poses for the GDD s5 action set.
The procedural capsule remains a play-safe fallback if the curated asset is missing or malformed.
